question: For carcinogenic molecules containing triple bonds, calculate the percentage of nitrogen atoms among all atoms in these molecules. Also identify which specific carcinogenic molecule with triple bonds has the highest count of nitrogen atoms.

WITH eligible_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m."XCL_010" AS "molecule_id"
    FROM molecule AS m
    INNER JOIN bond AS b ON m."XCL_010" = b."XCL_005"
    WHERE m."XCL_011" = '+' AND b."XCL_006" = '#'
),
atoms_in_scope AS (
    SELECT a."XCL_001" AS "atom_id", a."XCL_002" AS "molecule_id", a."XCL_003" AS "element_symbol"
    FROM atom AS a
    INNER JOIN eligible_molecules AS em ON a."XCL_002" = em."molecule_id"
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN t."element_symbol" = 'n' THEN t."atom_id" ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(t."atom_id") AS "nitrogen_percentage"
    FROM atoms_in_scope AS t
),
top_molecule AS (
    SELECT t."molecule_id" AS "molecule_id", COUNT(CASE WHEN t."element_symbol" = 'n' THEN t."atom_id" ELSE NULL END) AS "nitrogen_count"
    FROM atoms_in_scope AS t
    GROUP BY t."molecule_id"
    ORDER BY COUNT(CASE WHEN t."element_symbol" = 'n' THEN t."atom_id" ELSE NULL END) DESC, t."molecule_id" ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT p."nitrogen_percentage", tm."molecule_id"
FROM percentage AS p
CROSS JOIN top_molecule AS tm
